title.zh: 彭博终端接入 Hyperliquid 永续合约行情
title.en: Bloomberg Terminal Adds Hyperliquid Perpetuals Pricing

current_state.zh: 彭博终端已通过WSL HYPE工作表新增全天候Hyperliquid永续合约报价，将永续合约与大宗商品、指数、股票、外汇和加密货币的参考价格并列显示。
current_state.en: Bloomberg Terminal has added around-the-clock Hyperliquid perpetual futures pricing via a WSL HYPE worksheet that pairs perps with reference prices across commodities, indexes, equities, currencies and crypto.

updates.title_zh: 彭博终端现已支持全天候监测Hyperliquid上部分永续合约
updates.title_en: 彭博终端现已支持全天候监测Hyperliquid上部分永续合约
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 BlockBeats 与 Foresight News 报道，彭博终端（Bloomberg Terminal）现已支持用户全天候监测 Hyperliquid 上的部分永续合约，覆盖加密货币、股票、大宗商品、外汇和指数等多类资产。用户可通过输入代码 WSL HYPE 调取相关行情，但该整合暂不支持交易执行。

机构交易团队如今可以在原有工作流中，将 Hyperliquid 的价格与 BTC、英伟达、标普 500 指数、布伦特原油和欧元兑美元等传统市场基准进行比较。原文指出，这将提升 Hyperliquid 市场的曝光度和可信度，使其成为机构熟悉的价格来源之一。

该整合涉及的是行情数据，而非监管批准或交易准入；交易执行仍在彭博终端之外进行，相关报道称可实时查看超过 100 个合约的行情。
updates.what_changed_en: Bloomberg Terminal has begun supporting round-the-clock monitoring of selected Hyperliquid perpetual contracts across crypto, equities, commodities, FX and indices, without trading execution, expanding the venue's institutional data distribution.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Bloomberg Terminal has begun supporting round-the-clock monitoring of selected Hyperliquid perpetual contracts across crypto, equities, commodities, FX and indices, without trading execution, expanding the venue's institutional data distribution.
updates.background_zh: Hyperliquid 是一个链上交易场所，提供 300 多个永续合约与现货市场，全天候运行且非托管。永续合约是没有到期日的合约，通过资金费率机制使合约价格与参考资产价格保持一致。
updates.background_en: Hyperliquid is an on-chain venue offering 300-plus perpetual and spot markets that run 24/7 and are non-custodial. Perpetual futures are contracts without an expiration date that use a funding-rate mechanism to keep the contract price aligned with the reference asset.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这里的传导渠道是数据分发与情绪，而非资金流入：Hyperliquid 的永续合约价格如今与传统基准一同出现在机构终端中，可能提升专业用户对 Hyperliquid 市场及其 HYPE 代币的关注度。由于该行情为只读且不涉及交易执行，其本身并不会直接推动资金进入该平台。
updates.market_impact_en: The channel here is data distribution and sentiment rather than fund flow: Hyperliquid perpetual prices now sit alongside traditional benchmarks in an institutional terminal, which could increase attention on Hyperliquid markets and its HYPE token among professional users. Because the feed is read-only and involves no execution, it does not by itself move capital onto the venue.
